div.div: Q. Q. 1 أَثْفَى القِدْرَ : see 2. [But accord. to Az, in the T, يُؤَثْفِى, as aor. of أَثْفَى, is يُثْفِىreduced to its original form; and the like is said in the S and M in art. ثفى. If this be the case, مُؤَثْفَاةٌ, q. v., may be مُثْفَاةٌreduced in the same manner, i. e., to its original form.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
